name: Video Mix DJ Studio
summary: Load two YouTube videos into a responsive two-deck DJ studio. Crossfade their sound and picture, cue, loop, sync, adjust tempo and save your set on this device.

screenshots.alt: Video Mix DJ Studio showing two video decks, a central crossfader and a saved set panel

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Video Mix DJ Studio
config.description: Mix two YouTube videos with cue points, loops, tempo controls and a crossfader. Your set stays in this browser.

permissions.label: Embed the two YouTube videos you choose so they can be mixed in this browser
Keep your deck choices, cue points and saved set in this browser only
Add a Video Mix DJ button to the desktop rail that opens this studio in your browser
